team_history.note: Drafted Round 1, Pick 30 (acquired via trade with San Francisco) in 2026 NFL Draft out of Indiana.

workload.note: Led Indiana's undefeated national-championship team; newyorkjets.com lists 69 rec/937 yds (13.6 YPC)/13 TD, while 247sports.com lists 60 rec/937 yds/15 TD for the season — both sources agree on 937 yards; reception/TD counts conflict slightly. Career (247sports): 115 rec, 1,798 yards, 22 TD, 15.6 YPC. 4.42 40-yard dash at Combine; 6-0/199.
